Frequently Asked Questions

Is BI better than UETPESHAWAR?

Both BRAINS Institute Peshawar and University of Engineering & Technology Peshawar are HEC-recognized universities. BI is private (est. 1993) in Peshawar, while UETPESHAWAR is public (est. 1952) in Peshawar. The better choice depends on your field, budget, and merit — compare the details above.

What is the fee difference between BI and UETPESHAWAR?

BI's fee is approximately Rs. 39,000–60,000/sem per semester, while UETPESHAWAR's is Rs. 30–60K/sem. See the full comparison above.

What is the merit for BI and UETPESHAWAR?

BI: Admissions are granted strictly on merit. Undergraduate: Intermediate or equivalent qualification. Graduate: Bachelor's degree from an HEC-recognized institution. Postgraduate: relevant undergraduate qualification.. UETPESHAWAR: 60%+ in FSc (ETEA).
